summary.intent: Complete GSD Phase 63 planning verification by resolving all blocker findings from iteration 1 and passing all 12 verification dimensions.
summary.outcome: All three iteration-1 findings were fixed and committed; iteration 2 verification passed 12/12 dimensions. Post-verification gates (requirements coverage, decision coverage, STATE.md update, ROADMAP annotation) all completed successfully.

repo: GSD plan verification runs iteratively in subagents; iteration 1 surfaces blockers, iteration 2 confirms resolution — expect ~1-5 min per iteration with no intermediate output.
ROADMAP wave annotation is idempotent — re-running produces no diff when dependencies are already recorded.
Decision coverage gate reports as N/N PASS format (10/10 in this case).
workflow: Post-verification gates run sequentially after VERIFICATION PASSED: requirements coverage → decision coverage → STATE.md update (step 13b) → ROADMAP annotation (step 13c).
STATE.md records planning completion milestones and must be committed separately from plan/pattern files.

friction: GSD helper had a false-negative on the first iteration (commit 2c9ef1859 references 'GSD helper false-negative again'), requiring a second full verification subagent run.
Subagent verification produces no output for 1-5 minutes, which can appear as a freeze.
